topic: Calling a plumber for tiny fixes vs learning three basic home repairs (Ozzie vs Delilah)

scenes.narration: A short repair video can replace a two hundred dollar service call. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a wrench and a phone showing a repair video, comic burst banner reads FIX IT YOURSELF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ozzie and Delilah both have a running toilet and dripping faucet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man ozzie and woman delilah in bathrooms with a running toilet and dripping faucet, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each repair needs a four dollar part and ten minutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a small rubber flapper and a washer on a gym bench tagged FOUR DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ozzie calls a plumber for both jobs the same week.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ozzie phoning a plumber while a service van pulls up, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The service call alone costs one hundred twenty five dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an invoice line reading SERVICE CALL ONE TWENTY FIVE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His final bill lands at three hundred ten dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ozzie crushed under a barbell stamped THREE HUNDRED TEN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That running toilet also added nineteen dollars in water.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a water bill with an arrow reading PLUS NINETEEN and a toilet running, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Delilah watches two short repair videos first.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman delilah watching a phone repair video propped on a sink, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She buys a flapper and a washer for six dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman delilah at a hardware counter holding two tiny parts and a six dollar receipt, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both repairs are finished before her coffee cools.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman delilah wiping her hands beside a still steaming coffee mug, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same two repairs, three hundred four dollars apart.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a gym scoreboard reading THREE HUNDRED FOUR SAVED beside a toolbox, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Learn three small repairs this month. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading LEARN THREE REPAIRS, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
